_comment: The harness profile defaults per node TIER, declared ONCE (operator decision 2026-10-19). The gateway (gateway-rust/src/harness_profile.rs) resolves each node's profile from this table: per field, a per-node OVERRIDE (noo_node_config.harness_profile, `noo cluster profile <node> --set k=v`) beats a MEASURED value (the node's heartbeat model_bench; first_byte_secs only, and only when the bench is of the node's running chat model) beats the tier default here. A tier this table does not list (or a node whose tier cannot be derived) reads as unknown_tier. The resolved profile ships in GET /api/cluster/nodes/{id}/desired-config as `harness_profile`; the node agent applies first_byte_secs, ollama_context and foreign_kinds and hands the whole profile to its harness in /harness/placement, which applies stream_idle_secs, thinking and claude_prompt. noo-cli embeds this file too (`noo cluster profile`). Fields: first_byte_secs = the node agent inference proxy's wait for a model's first byte (env NOO_BACKEND_FIRST_BYTE_TIMEOUT_SECS overrides it on a box with no profile); stream_idle_secs = the harness/gateway stream idle bound (NOO_BACKEND_STREAM_IDLE_SECS); thinking = on|off|auto default for NOO_HARNESS_THINKING; ollama_context = the default context window for the node's chat engine when its placement sets none (OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH for ollama, VLLM_MAX_MODEL_LEN for vllm, N_CTX for llamacpp; the name is historical); claude_prompt = full|slim Claude Code launch variant; foreign_kinds = the foreign harness kinds (config/harness-kinds.json) this node may run, `noo` always allowed. measured: first_byte_secs = ceil((load_secs + reference_prompt_tokens / prefill_tps) * headroom), never below the tier default, never above max_first_byte_secs.
